authorization: Owner instruction, 27 September 2026: run the GSE190821 epithelial arm to bound rival 2

scope.bounds: A15 rival 2 only: that Itgb6 loss changes the epithelium itself, so a changed epithelium could change a fibroblast for reasons unrelated to TGF-beta activation
scope.is_not: a test of A15. This deposit fails A15 stage 1 gate conditions 3, 4 and 5: no activated-TGF-beta readout, no separated fibroblast compartment, no ligand arm.
scope.may_never_be_reported_as: evidence for or against the A15 hypothesis

source_paper.citation: Auyeung VC, Downey MS, Thamsen M, Wenger TA, Backes BJ, Sheppard D, Papa FR. IRE1alpha drives lung epithelial progenitor dysfunction to establish a niche for pulmonary fibrosis. Am J Physiol Lung Cell Mol Physiol 2022
source_paper.reading_policy: not under the roadmap-14 unread-source prohibition; A1 already cited its Fig. 1K and Supplemental Table 1
source_paper.consequence: agreement is reproduction and is reported as reproduction, never as a finding of this repository
source_paper.prior_exposure_recorded: this session read the abstract, which states that the IRE1alpha inhibitor decreases integrin alphaVbeta6 expression with correspondingly decreased TGF-beta-induced gene expression in the epithelium. The primary endpoint below is not a TGF-beta response module, so this does not reveal the primary's direction.
source_paper.order_required: freeze, then compute, then compare against the paper

unit.justification: every mouse carries exactly one epithelial library, so the epithelial arm has no pseudoreplication

eligibility.batch: S151 for every arm used, so treatment is separable from batch

excluded.Vehicle: the KIRA8 vehicle, not the antibody control; pooling it with Axum8 is the naming hazard stage 1 found
excluded.Whole Lung: a homogenate cannot isolate the epithelial compartment, and A15's gate condition 4 refuses it

primary.name: A0 frozen transition programme, 50 mouse genes
primary.defined_in: Strunz mouse alveolar repair, a different dataset
primary.why: it is a transition-associated epithelial programme, which is exactly the epithelial state change rival 2 asserts, and it was frozen without any reference to GSE190821

secondary.name: A5/A11 injury residual module, 386 mouse genes
secondary.why: a larger, independently partitioned injury programme; agreement between a 50-gene and a 373-gene set is worth more than either alone

excluded_as_endpoints.a1_frozen_marker_panel: contains Itgb6; retained for per-gene reporting only, with no decision attached

endpoints.scoring: per mouse, the mean over recovered members of log2(count / that library's total count * 1e6 + 1)
endpoints.scoring_provenance: the same per-library CPM convention A2 leg 1 used for its frozen five-gene score; it is this repository's own convention and is NOT edgeR TMM
endpoints.r_unavailable: no R interpreter exists in this session, so A1's edgeR TMM and quasi-likelihood instrument cannot be reused. Reimplementing TMM and presenting it as edgeR output is refused.

statistic.primary_effect: mean score of the 3G9 arm minus mean score of the Axum8 bleomycin arm, in log2 CPM units
also_reported: how many of the 4 treated mice fall inside the reference arm's range
statistic.test: exact two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum over all 70 assignments, computed by complete enumeration rather than a normal approximation
statistic.instrument_check_effect: mean score of the Axum8 bleomycin arm minus mean score of the Axum8 saline arm, same score, same batch, same antibody
statistic.instrument_check_test: exact one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum over all 35 assignments
statistic.yardstick: ratio of the absolute primary effect to the absolute instrument-check effect
statistic.no_multiple_testing_family_beyond: two endpoints and one instrument check

instrument_check.requirement: the A0 transition programme must be higher in bleomycin than in saline, one-sided p <= 0.05 at the exact test's floor of 0.0286
instrument_check.if_it_fails: nothing is read and the failure is the result
instrument_check.not_independent_validation: the A0 programme was discovered in mouse bleomycin alveolar repair, so a large bleomycin effect is expected by construction. This is an instrument check, not a validation of the programme.

margins_declared_before_any_value_is_rea.bounded: absolute primary effect <= 0.25 times the absolute instrument-check effect, with the two arms' ranges overlapping
margins_declared_before_any_value_is_rea.rival_stays_live: absolute primary effect >= 0.50 times the absolute instrument-check effect
margins_declared_before_any_value_is_rea.inconclusive: between 0.25 and 0.50, or if the instrument check fails, or if the two criteria for bounded disagree
margins_declared_before_any_value_is_rea.why_these_numbers: at 4 against 4 nothing finer is readable, and two thresholds with an explicit inconclusive zone are preferred to a single cut that would force a binary the design cannot support

declared_reading.a_small_effect_bounds_rival_2: if blocking the integrin does not move the epithelium's own programme on the scale that injury moves it, then a grossly restructured epithelium is a weak explanation for the organoid fibroblast effect
declared_reading.a_large_effect_does_not_establish_rival_: an epithelial change under integrin blockade is equally consistent with the mechanism A15 proposes, since less activated TGF-beta would itself change the epithelium. Only the null direction is informative.
declared_reading.neither_outcome_touches_a15: this deposit cannot measure activated TGF-beta, cannot separate a fibroblast compartment, and has no ligand arm

limits_declared_before_any_value_is_read: Four mice against four. Precise absence is unavailable and no bound will be reported as absence.
The exact test can reach nominal significance only under complete separation of the arms.

A systemic blocking antibody at day 7 in a mouse lung is not a two-week organoid co-culture of mouse epithelium with human fibroblasts. A bound here transfers to the organoid system as a plausibility argument, not as a fact.
Antibody blockade is partial and dose-dependent, so this is not a genetic null of the integrin.
The epithelial compartment is a RiboTag immunoprecipitation, measuring ribosome-associated RNA rather than total RNA, and its purity is not verified in the deposit.

An epithelial compartment's subtype composition can itself shift under injury, so a programme score cannot separate a state change from a composition change. This is A10's caution, inherited in A10's words.
The source paper likely reports a 3G9 epithelial contrast, so agreement is reproduction and not a finding of this repository.
No claim row is added and no register grade changes.
prohibitions: no substitution of the endpoint after any value is read, including after the source paper's results are read
no reading of this result as evidence for or against the A15 hypothesis
no whole-lung score reported as a fibroblast compartment readout
no pooling of Axum8 with Vehicle as a bleomycin control arm
no normal approximation where an exact enumeration is available
no claim row, and no re-grading of any existing row
no TMM normalisation presented as edgeR output
no therapeutic reading in either direction

sensitivities_required.normalisation: median-of-ratios size factors computed in this repository, fully specified, labelled as this repository's implementation and not as DESeq2 output
sensitivities_required.depth: the primary score regressed on log library total across the eight primary-arm mice, reported whatever it shows
sensitivities_required.leave_one_mouse_out: the primary effect recomputed with each of the eight mice dropped in turn, reported as a table
sensitivities_required.secondary_endpoint: the whole reading repeated on the 373-gene injury residual module
